reported.title: Blocking chime pulse starves heartbeat
reported.description: pulseChimeBlocking() uses delay(1800), so the loop cannot print the 300 ms heartbeat for 1.8 s, violating the 700 ms silence limit and the requirement to print gate-hb while the chime sounds.

reported.title: No debounce or settling on gate contact
reported.description: gateOpened() triggers on a single raw LOW sample, so contact bounce or a brief glitch can start a chime even though the behaviour requires a settled 40 ms open event.

reported.title: Chime retriggers while already sounding
reported.description: Because the pulse is blocking and there is no active-pulse state, a held-open gate restarts the chime immediately after each pulse instead of ignoring presses while the chime is sounding.

reported.title: No 150 ms response deadline enforcement
reported.description: The sketch has no non-blocking state machine tracking the open event and pulse start, so it cannot guarantee the chime starts within 150 ms of a settled open event.

exposing_checks.behaviour: serial lines matching '^gate-hb$' every 300 ms (Gate heartbeat)
responds to stimulus within None ms (Stay responsive)

judge_input.spec:
- Porch gate contact on D3 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW when open); chime driver on D10.
- A settled open event as short as 40 ms starts an 1800 ms HIGH pulse on D10 within 150 ms.
- Presses while the chime is already sounding are ignored (pulse length is not restarted).
- Print the exact line `gate-hb` every 300 ms continuously, including while the chime is sounding.
- Never remain silent (no serial and no output change) for more than 700 ms.
- Closed/idle gate reads HIGH on D3.
